toolRoutes.bash: host Pi formatting and operations -> bound admission -> native shell worker
toolRoutes.files: host Pi schemas/renderers -> bound admission -> public Pi definitions inside native worker
toolRoutes.codemode: public built-in QuickJS -> ctx.executeTool -> same final wrappers
toolRoutes.userBash: always handled operations; final prefix/cwd/env/options rechecked

trustBoundaries: Pi and explicitly trusted extensions are controllers
remote MCP internals and arbitrary trusted in-process effects are outside native workload confinement
unknown tools require explicit trusted adapters
